name: release without leaking a burned seed
text: The private nano-mcp repo's git history once contained a real Nano test seed (now treated as burned). Flipping the repo public would expose it, so a NEW public repo must be created from a clean, squashed snapshot that provably contains no secrets.

name: publish a usable, honest package
text: The public artifact must actually install and work (pyproject + wheel + tests passing offline), have a README that says it is AI-built with a 5-minute quickstart, and must not ship the withdrawn draft/x402 P1 duplicate.

name: measure the release is done and clean
text: A law with an observable test must prove the public repo exists and pushed, the secret scan returned zero flags on the snapshot, and the wheel builds and (with a token) publishes to PyPI under the agent account.
